title: Optical Overlay Metrology - ESD Damage Detection on C205 Broadband Plasma
subtitle: Post-Lithography Quality Validation for 45nm Node Manufacturing
author: Emily Nakamura

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the C205 Broadband Plasma system to detect and classify ESD Damage defects during post-lithography inspection at the 45nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab B to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 300mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for ESD Damage defects that are critical to yield at the 45nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the C205 Broadband Plasma platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: C205 Broadband Plasma
- Inspection Type: Optical Overlay Metrology
- Target Defect: ESD Damage
- Process Step: Post-Lithography
- Wafer Size: 300mm
- Technology Node: 45nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab B

This test case applies to all C205 Broadband Plasma systems deployed at Milpitas Fab B for post-lithography monitoring in the 45nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: C205 Broadband Plasma
Software Version: v11.8.303
Recipe: OPTICAL_OVERLAY_METROLOGY_45nm_POST_LITHOGRAPHY
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (74 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the C205 Broadband Plasma system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Optical Overlay Metrology' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target ESD Damage defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 45nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 64 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.8% for Optical Overlay Metrology
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-03-25
Wafers Tested: 15
Total Defects Found: 4151
Defect Density: 587.25 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 5.6%
Capture Rate: 96.2%
Test Duration: 46 minutes
System Uptime: 96.8%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The C205 Broadband Plasma demonstrated below-target performance in detecting ESD Damage at the 45nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
